'''Geharr''' was a major [[City/Legends|city]] located on a [[Geharran city continent|city continent]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Gimmel/Legends|Ord Gimmel]]. Geharr was originally composed of six separate cities, which over time coalesced into one. The city's name meant "Keeper of the Faithful."<ref name="Strongholds" />
